title: ID0415968-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / P7 170000744] Switching matrix fail
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Switching matrix fail. When someone is isung outlet 2, outlet 1 goes out of order.
Root cause:
QA09-10 faulty
Solution: Replace QA09-10
